title: PhyMind: Physics-Informed Masked Autoencoding for EEG Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28856v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: EEG foundation models are pre-trained almost exclusively with masked reconstruction through a free-form decoder, sometimes with hand-crafted spectral targets added, as in MANAS-2. We study what happens when that decoder is replaced by a generative forward model of EEG. PhyMind keeps a standard masked transformer encoder, but its decoder must explain the masked signal through 68 cortical regions, each driven by damped stochastic oscillators and an aperiodic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, projected to the recording's own montage by a fixed boundary-element lead field evaluated per derivation. Training combines masked reconstruction with a Whittle spectral likelihood, an oscillator-dynamics residual, a minimum-norm source prior and a penalised neural residual. In a controlled comparison (same encoder, data, steps and seed), the physics decoder produces encoder tokens whose spectral content is far more linearly decodable than with a masked-auto

translated_title: PhyMind：面向脑电（EEG）基础模型的物理信息掩码自编码
translated_abstract: EEG基础模型几乎全部通过自由形式解码器进行掩码重建预训练，有时还会加入手工设计的频谱目标（如MANAS-2）。我们研究了当把该解码器替换为EEG的生成式前向模型时会发生什么。PhyMind保留了标准的掩码Transformer编码器，但其解码器必须通过68个皮层区域来解释被掩蔽的信号，每个区域由阻尼随机振荡器和非周期性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程驱动，并通过在每条导联上计算的固定边界元导联场投影到该记录自身的电极配置上。训练将掩码重建与Whittle频谱似然、振荡器动力学残差、最小范数源先验以及惩罚性神经残差相结合。在受控比较（相同的编码器、数据、训练步数和随机种子）中，物理解码器所产生的编码器token，其频谱内容的线性可解码性远高于掩码自编码基线……
tldr: PhyMind用基于68个皮层区域振荡动力学与边界元导联场的物理生成式前向模型，替代EEG基础模型中传统的自由形式解码器，通过物理信息掩码自编码预训练显著提升了编码器表征中频谱信息的线性可解码性。
en_tdlr: PhyMind replaces the free-form decoder in EEG foundation models with a physics-informed generative forward model built on 68 cortical-region oscillator dynamics and boundary-element lead fields, substantially improving the linear decodability of spectral content in encoder representations.
